data.description: A crimson fungus is a fungus found in crimson and warped forests or by using bone meal on nylium. It can grow into a huge crimson fungus if bone mealed, but only if planted on crimson nylium. It can also be fed to hoglins.

<p>A <b>crimson fungus</b> is a <a href="/w/Fungus" class="mw-disambig" title="Fungus">fungus</a> found in <a href="/w/Crimson_Forest" title="Crimson Forest">crimson</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forests</a> or by <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">using</span> <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> on <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a>. It can grow into a <a href="/w/Huge_crimson_fungus" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge crimson fungus">huge crimson fungus</a> if bone mealed, but only if planted on <a href="/w/Crimson_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson nylium">crimson nylium</a>. It can also be fed to <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a>.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Natural_generation">Natural generation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=3&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Natural generation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section's source code: Natural generation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Crimson fungi naturally generate in the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forest</a> biomes, with crimson fungus most commonly generating in its respective biome, the crimson forest and less frequently in the other, the warped forest.
</p>
<div class="mcw-calc" data-type="blockDistribution" data-page-name="Crimson Fungus" data-blocks="minecraft:crimson_fungus" data-block-names="Crimson Fungus"></div>

</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Post-generation">Post-generation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Post-generation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Post-generation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Applying <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> to <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a> causes crimson fungi to appear nearby, similar to <a href="/w/Flower" title="Flower">flowers</a> on <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a>. While crimson fungi and other Nether vegetation can generate this way, they are more likely to be the same type as the nylium.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Usage">Usage</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=7&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Usage" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section's source code: Usage"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Placement">Placement</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=8&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Placement" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section's source code: Placement"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:FungusPlaceBlock.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/FungusPlaceBlock.png/300px-FungusPlaceBlock.png?7158f" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="165" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/FungusPlaceBlock.png/600px-FungusPlaceBlock.png?7158f 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="1057"></a><figcaption>All of the blocks that crimson fungi can be placed on</figcaption></figure>
<p>Crimson fungi may be placed on <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Dirt" title="Dirt">dirt</a>, <a href="/w/Coarse_dirt" class="mw-redirect" title="Coarse dirt">coarse dirt</a>, <a href="/w/Podzol" title="Podzol">podzol</a>, <a href="/w/Farmland" title="Farmland">farmland</a>, <a href="/w/Rooted_dirt" class="mw-redirect" title="Rooted dirt">rooted dirt</a>, <a href="/w/Moss_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Moss block">moss blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a>, <a href="/w/Mycelium" title="Mycelium">mycelium</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>, <a href="/w/Mud" title="Mud">mud</a>, and <a href="/w/Muddy_mangrove_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Muddy mangrove roots">muddy mangrove roots</a>. Attempting to place it on any other block fails. Crimson fungi requires a solid block underneath it, and pops off and drops itself if it is no longer supported.
</p><p>Crimson fungi can also be placed in <a href="/w/Flower_pot" class="mw-redirect" title="Flower pot">flower pots</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Growth">Growth</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=9&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Growth" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section's source code: Growth"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>When <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> is <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">used</span> on a crimson fungus that is planted on <a href="/w/Crimson_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson nylium">crimson nylium</a>, it has a 40% chance to grow into a <a href="/w/Huge_crimson_fungus" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge crimson fungus">huge crimson fungus</a>. The <a href="/w/Crimson_stem" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson stem">crimson stem</a>, <a href="/w/Shroomlight" title="Shroomlight">shroomlight</a>, or <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a> may replace certain blocks including <a href="/w/Slab" title="Slab">slabs</a> and <a href="/w/Torch" title="Torch">torches</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Breeding">Breeding</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=10&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Breeding" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section's source code: Breeding"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Crimson fungus can be used to breed <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a> and keep them from despawning, but feeding hoglins does not stop them from attacking the player.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Composting">Composting</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?section=11&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Composting" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Crimson_Fungus?action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section's source code: Composting"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Placing a crimson fungus into a <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composter</a> has a 65% chance of raising the compost level by 1.
</p>

metadata.description: A crimson fungus is a fungus found in crimson and warped forests or by using bone meal on nylium. It can grow into a huge crimson fungus if bone mealed, but only if planted on crimson nylium. It can also be fed to hoglins.
